summary: First Majestic Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 13, 2026 news release announcing a temporary suspension of its NAFTA Chapter 11 arbitration against Mexico over the legacy tax dispute of subsidiary Primero Empresa Minera. The tribunal ordered proceedings suspended until December 31, 2026, with possible extension into Q1 2027, as the parties agreed in principle to a settlement framework. No monetary terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor were disclosed. The arbitration may resume if no final settlement is reached, making resolution timing the key watch item.
